recomputation_method.stand_scene_means: Native report group means use SUM over valid first-episode frames divided by reported frames (EpisodeMetrics lines62-104,156-169). This review checks frame/replica denominators and units, reconstructs aggregate numerators as mean*frames, and recomputes the three-scene pooled values weighted by frames. Original per-frame 50Hz sums were not saved; no claim of independent full-frame metric replay.
recomputation_method.fallen_successes: Count true_success=1 and failed=0 in ended native episodes; cross-check per-replica native_task_success_unscored and physical_full_chain_completed diagnostics and native metric successes. Denominator is all four ended original births per scene, including failures.
